messages:
eli: hey everyone, i'm eli (platform eng)  day 1. trying to run the private-deploy quickstart that hits both our aws eu account and a gcp sandbox in europe. getting blocked on two things at once: can't assume the org role in aws eu and can't access the KMS key in the gcp project. who should I loop in?

onboard-bot: welcome @eli! for cross-cloud access tag @rana (infra) and @tom (security). onboarding guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/cloud-access

rana: hi @eli  can you paste the exact errors? is the AWS problem at console switch-role or sts:AssumeRole? For GCP, which key and project id?

eli: aws console switch-role 403 and CLI `aws sts assume-role` fails: ```An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User: arn:aws:iam::444444444444:user/eli is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/OrgDeployRole```

eli: GCP error when decrypting during the deploy: `PERMISSION_DENIED: Cloud KMS permission denied` targeting project `redwood-private-sbx-eu` and keyring `private-keyring-eu` in `europe-west3`.

rana: thanks. quick notes: AWS likely blocked by org-level SCP or missing cross-account trust. GCP likely needs a cryptoKeyDecrypter on the crypto key or keyring. Can you run `aws sts get-caller-identity` and `gcloud auth list` and paste outputs? if not, screenshot is fine.

eli: caller id: ```{"UserId":"AIDELI...","Account":"444444444444","Arn":"arn:aws:iam::444444444444:user/eli"}``` gcloud auth list shows my account email but `gcloud kms keys list` returns PERMISSION_DENIED.

tom: looping security - hi @security. two things to check: (1) Are we intentionally blocking cross-account assume to prevent lateral movement? (2) Is the KMS key in a restricted perimeter or using a customer-managed key with IAM bindings limited to service accounts only?

security: hey. we do restrict broad assume-role across some EU accounts for Private deployments. For KMS we bind only service accounts used by our control plane; we avoid granting users direct decrypt on production keys. For sandboxes we sometimes make exceptions. Please file a ticket with justification and exact operations you need.

rana: approach: (A) short-term workaround - spin the quickstart against our shared dev sandbox in us-central1 where your role is already permitted, or (B) if you need EU specifically, infra can add an explicit trust policy for your user to assume `OrgDeployRole` in the EU account and grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the test keyring in `redwood-private-sbx-eu` for 24-48h. Which do you prefer?

eli: need EU to validate region-specific network routes and KMS-backed secrets. I'll take the temporary grants. I'll open the ticket. What's the ticket template?

onboard-bot: please open INFRA access ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/ with component=cloud-access. Include: caller id, target account ids, project ids, keynames, exact commands you will run, duration requested, and manager approval. Tag @rana and @security.

eli: created INFRA-4001. included caller id, account ids (444444444444 -> aws dev, 555555555555 -> aws eu prod, project redwood-private-sbx-eu), keyring and requested 48h access. attached screenshot of the AWS assume-role error and GCP kms error.

finance-bot: INFRA-4001 created and assigned to infra. Note: if GCP project is not linked to billing, KMS ops may be restricted. Please include billing account id if you expect to create resources. Typical SLA: 1-2 business days for access grants.

security: acknowledged INFRA-4001. We'll review and likely approve a scoped grant for 48h provided Eli uses the sandbox and not prod keys. We'll also require you to use MFA and to sign the access request form.

rana: infra will verify org policies and apply a temporary trust and KMS binding. If org SCP blocks adding the trust, we may instead create a short-lived service account with the exact permissions and provide you a token to use.

eli: thanks  added manager approval to INFRA-4001 and requested `48h` with exact commands: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/OrgDeployRole --role-session-name eli-quickstart` and `gcloud kms decrypt --location=europe-west3 --keyring=private-keyring-eu --key=deploy-key --ciphertext-file=secret.enc --plaintext-file=secret.txt`

rana: perfect. i'll pick this up now and DM if we need more info. if all goes well i'll push the grants and post the confirmation here.

eli: appreciate it. i'll standby and test once you confirm. thanks team :rocket:
